story: Paddy Mac's opened its doors in the winter of 1995, and a good number of the staff who started that year are still here. That isn't a marketing line. It's just what happened.
Hugh came over from Cork and built the sort of room he'd have wanted to walk into. Dark wood. No televisions shouting over the music. A pint given the full time it needs to settle.
Somewhere along the way the pub sponsored one of the first girls' soccer teams in Palm Beach Gardens. They were called the Shamrocks. People still bring it up at the bar.
